integrity: Analytical all-parameter derivation; independently built full-state finite numerical checks corroborate but do not prove arbitrary-parameter conclusions. Earlier general activity formalism and a covered square special case are credited.
scientific_limitations: Only two indistinguishable hard-core particles with uniform symmetric unit edge rates, all successful jumps counted, finite Hamming graphs, equilibrium initial law; high-dimensional expansion fixes alphabet size; no process-level Poisson limit or higher-cumulant result.
title: Exact jump-activity noise for two-particle exclusion on Hamming graphs
